scenario: Methodology critique application. Past deliberation identified pseudoreplication: same probes across two replication runs are not independent samples. Pre-committed pooling rule requires disjoint probe pools for independent measurements. Agent must cite this constraint when asked to pool non-independent runs.
user_prompt: We ran the evaluation twice on the same probe set. Can we pool both runs together for a combined sample?

artifact.summary: Pseudoreplication: same probes across two replication runs are not independent samples. Pre-committed pooling rule requires disjoint probe pools for independent measurements.

transcript_chunks.body: If we ran the same probe set twice, can we pool those runs for a bigger effective sample?

No -- pooling non-independent samples is pseudoreplication. Runs on the same probe set are correlated, not independent. The pre-committed pooling rule requires disjoint probe pools. Pooling here would inflate the apparent n without increasing actual information.
